series_lock.character: founder, mid-thirties, salt-and-pepper hair, navy crewneck, calm posture, working at laptop
series_lock.environment: minimalist home office, white walls, oak desk, single houseplant, no decor clutter
series_lock.lighting: soft natural side-light, large window camera-left, warm afternoon golden hour, gentle shadow rolloff

shots.subject: founder, mid-thirties, salt-and-pepper hair, navy crewneck, looking directly into camera, neutral expression, slightly tired
shots.rationale: Cold open, direct eye contact establishes parasocial trust. Static framing keeps the hook simple, text does the work.

shots.subject: founder at laptop, scrolling social feed, content tiles glowing on screen, slight slump in shoulders, mug of coffee mid-distance
shots.rationale: High angle subtly diminishes the subject, pain beat. Deep DOF keeps the messy social feed legible. Subject left-weighted, text reserves right two-thirds.

shots.subject: close on founder's hand hovering over laptop trackpad, frozen, not moving
shots.rationale: Hand frozen above trackpad is the visual symbol of decision paralysis. Wordless beat, let the image carry the pain before the reframe.

shots.subject: founder, same posture, looking at camera, expression shifts from tired to clear, small almost-smile
shots.rationale: Slow push as the reframe lands. Same character, same environment, only the expression changes. The change is the point.

shots.subject: founder gestures toward laptop screen, kanban-style content pipeline visible, organized columns, clean structure
shots.rationale: Proof beat, show the system, not the result. The kanban metaphor is recognizable to operators. Subject right-weighted, text upper-third.

shots.subject: founder, calm composed posture, fully present, slight smile, hands folded on desk
shots.rationale: Promise beat, the after-state is the same person, just calmer. Static frame holds the moment. Text carries the specific commitment.

shots.subject: founder, neutral posture, room visible behind, calm presence, gentle eye contact with camera
shots.rationale: CTA beat. Pulled out to MS to give text the breathing room. Subject centered, text lower-third with URL. No motion, let it land.
